implementation.title: Data model & provenance
implementation.body: Every object points to literal source anchors and spans. Current lines and hashes are resolved during extraction. Missing anchors remain visible as stale provenance.

implementation.title: Extraction
implementation.body: Python reads owned file globs, counts non-blank text lines and records Git facts. External roles are inferred from repository references.

implementation.title: Maturity
implementation.body: Sourced overrides, deployment proof, observed bound tests, exact placeholder signatures and file presence determine one maturity state. A command with no collected tests cannot establish tested maturity.

implementation.title: Layered layout
implementation.body: Source-to-gate ranks and deterministic barycenter ordering place modules in separate zone lanes. Content changes retain their positions. Height encodes owned lines; no performance or latency is implied.

implementation.title: Rendering & fallback
implementation.body: A perspective WebGL2 board uses crisp vector-like figures and selectable DOM titles. Canvas 2D and the keyboard-accessible Outline provide fallback views. Plan view is orthographic.

sources.anchor: export function create3D(canvas,model){let context=null;try{context=canvas.getContext('webgl2',{alpha:false,antialias:true,powerPreference:'low-power'});}catch{}if(!context)return null;return new Engine3D(canvas,model,context);}

implementation.title: Live updates & checks
implementation.body: The local server watches repository inputs and sends patches. Only audited, fixed commands can run. Private-authority checks stay unavailable; local receipt shape preflight never grants a proof verdict.

implementation.title: Scope & authority
implementation.body: This map is administrative and never earns Foundation credit. It does not write receipts, authorize promotions, change schedules or inspect the private vault.
